=== all history for config/runtime ===
=== compose.dev ===
services:
  app:
    environment:
      SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED: 'true'
      SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER: 'https://keycloak.smart-village.app/realms/studio-dev'
      SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE: 'sva-studio-mcp'
      SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID: 'sva-studio-mcp'
    image: ${IMAGE_REF:-ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:${TAG:-latest}}
    networks:
      - network-node-005
      - default
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == node-005.sva
      restart_policy:
        condition: any
        delay: 5s
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
        limits:
          memory: 512M
      labels:
        - 'sva.config.revision=${SVA_CONFIG_REVISION}'
        - 'traefik.docker.network=network-node-005'
        - 'traefik.enable=true'
        - 'traefik.frontend.passHostHeader=true'
        - 'traefik.frontend.rule=Host:studio-dev.smart-village.app,de-teststadt-dev.studio-dev.smart-village.app,readiness-smoke-20260927.studio-dev.smart-village.app'
        - 'traefik.port=3000'
        - 'traefik.http.routers.studio-dev-app.rule=Host(`studio-dev.smart-village.app`) || Host(`de-teststadt-dev.studio-dev.smart-village.app`) || Host(`readiness-smoke-20260927.studio-dev.smart-village.app`)'
        - 'traefik.http.routers.studio-dev-app.entrypoints=web,websecure'
        - 'traefik.http.routers.studio-dev-app.tls=true'
        - 'traefik.http.routers.studio-dev-app.tls.certresolver=default'
        - 'traefik.http.services.studio-dev-app.loadbalancer.server.port=3000'

  provisioner:
    image: ${IMAGE_REF:-ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:${TAG:-latest}}
    networks:
      - default
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      update_config:
        parallelism: 1
        order: stop-first
        failure_action: pause
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == node-005.sva
      restart_policy:
        condition: any
        delay: 5s
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
        limits:
          memory: 256M

  migrate:
    image: ${IMAGE_REF:-ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:${TAG:-latest}}
    networks:
      - default
    deploy:
      replicas: 0
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == node-005.sva
      restart_policy:
        condition: none
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
        limits:
          memory: 256M

  bootstrap:
    image: ${IMAGE_REF:-ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:${TAG:-latest}}
    networks:
      - default
    deploy:
      replicas: 0
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == node-005.sva
      restart_policy:
        condition: none
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
        limits:
          memory: 256M

  redis:
    networks:
      - default
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == node-005.sva
      restart_policy:
        condition: any
        delay: 5s
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
        limits:
          memory: 256M

  postgres:
    networks:
      - default
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == node-005.sva
      restart_policy:
        condition: any

observation.command: cd /workspace && git log --all --diff-filter=D --name-only --pretty=format: -- 'config/runtime/base.vars' 'config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars' 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "=== all history for config/runtime ==="; git log --all --oneline --follow -- config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== compose.dev ==="; sed -n '1,120p' deploy/compose.dev.yaml
